You’re listening to Bark & Wag 15 Minute Vet Talk. Each week your host Polly ReQua interviews Veterinarians and individuals in the pet industry from across the nation answering pet questions.  Bark & Wag podcast is produced weekly for your enjoyment and show notes can be found at barknwag.com under the podcast tab. 
Please remember to subscribe to Bark & Wag 15 Minute Vet Talk podcast on iTunes, Stitcher and iHeartRadio.
